name: player-pilot
title: Player Pilot
description: Control every running media player through playerctl, with a grid and a side-panel view.
author: black

commands.name: player-pilot
commands.title: Player Pilot
commands.subtitle: Control every running media player
commands.description: List every player playerctl can see, play, pause, skip and stop each of them, and switch between a grid and a side-panel view.

commands.name: resume-track
commands.title: Resume Music
commands.subtitle: Resume currently paused media
commands.description: Play the preferred players, or every player when no filter is set.

commands.name: pause-track
commands.title: Pause Music
commands.subtitle: Pause currently played media
commands.description: Pause the preferred players, or every player when no filter is set.

commands.name: next-track
commands.title: Next Track
commands.subtitle: Play next track
commands.description: Skip to the next track on the preferred players, or on every player.

commands.name: previous-track
commands.title: Previous Track
commands.subtitle: Play previous track
commands.description: Skip back on the preferred players, or on every player.

preferences.name: playerctl-players
preferences.title: Players
preferences.description: Comma-separated player names to show, like 'spotify,firefox'. '%any' shows every player playerctl reports.
